title: Atlas HTTP 2.0 migration guide
text: Atlas HTTP 2.0 replaces Client(timeout=<seconds>) with Client(timeout_ms=<milliseconds>). The get method remains available. Applications should migrate timeout values explicitly and run request timeout regression tests before upgrading.

title: Nimbus Cache 4.0 migration guide
text: Nimbus Cache 4 removes CacheClient.get. Use CacheClient.fetch(key, namespace=<name>) instead. The namespace is mandatory so shared cache keys remain isolated. Test cache misses and namespace separation during migration.

title: SQLite deployment characteristics
text: SQLite is an embedded database with no separate server. It is well suited to local applications with modest write concurrency and simple backup requirements. Workloads with many concurrent writers or horizontal read scaling may require a client-server database.

title: PostgreSQL scaling characteristics
text: PostgreSQL supports concurrent clients, server-managed access control, replication, and operational monitoring. It requires a running database service and additional deployment and backup operations compared with an embedded database.

title: Cache worker configuration reference
text: When CACHE_MODE is shared, CACHE_NAMESPACE is required and must be unique per deployment. For local mode the namespace is optional. A missing namespace causes startup validation to fail before the worker connects to the cache endpoint.
